heading: Screenwriting & stage work
intro: A running collection of scripts, stage work, and pieces in development.

pieces.title: Terms of Admission
pieces.blurb: At his family's status-conscious holiday party, a college-aged son fields a gauntlet of judgment about his choice to skip college — and finds the charm he's performing all night curdling into something sharper.

pieces.title: Opening Night
pieces.blurb: A shy freshman is offered a shot at the main cast on opening night of the spring musical — and has to decide whether the friendship she'd be leaving behind is worth it.

pieces.title: Red Herring
pieces.blurb: A college sophomore wakes up covered in blood with no memory of the night before, and spirals into a panicked confession spree before learning the awful truth was just a fraternity prank.

pieces.title: Motherlover
pieces.tag: Short film script · 2 pages · co-written with Alara McPhee
pieces.blurb: A Parents' Weekend reunion turns mortifying when a friend reveals exactly who he's been secretly courting.

pieces.title: Between Love and Walls
pieces.blurb: Told across three ages of the same two people — 7, 14, and 18 — a friendship that almost became something more finally runs out of promises to keep.

pieces.title: Interlude
pieces.tag: Short film script · 4 pages · rough draft
pieces.blurb: Told through a one-sided voicemail and looping memories, two former lovers relive the arc of a relationship that's already over.
